discovery.name: Juyi Hall readiness
discovery.meaning: Capture current DOM and mark BLOCKED if no source-derived route surface appears.

discovery.name: explicit assignment
discovery.meaning: Operator supplies a live target selector after DOM discovery; exact target agent ID must be collected from real response.

discovery.name: deliberation state
discovery.meaning: Observe real state only; it does not prove execution alone.

discovery.name: image preview
discovery.meaning: Require naturalWidth and naturalHeight greater than zero and decoded browser image; URL existence is insufficient.

discovery.name: download
discovery.meaning: Browser download bytes, headers and UI-observed request are recorded; SHA-256 is computed over downloaded bytes.

discovery.name: text archive
textCandidates: 保存选中文字到工作空间
discovery.meaning: Selection and returned archive identity are collected from the actual session.

discovery.name: controlled edit consent
textCandidates: 核对本次受控图像办理
我明确确认本次单次受控图像请求
discovery.meaning: Only a visible server-backed preview and real user consent can advance the edit; no synthetic event or API substitute.

discovery.name: finalization
discovery.meaning: Record selected output IDs and separate delivery/decision/task-completed facts.
